title: Write a CPlusPlus TOP
summary: Official Derivative guide for CPlusPlus TOP authoring, covering multi-texture TOP output, CPU memory and CUDA execute modes, header/sample workflow, 2022.20000+ upgrade guidance, and CUDA main-thread operation boundaries.
guidance: Use this article when a plan needs native TOP plugin output semantics, CUDA-aware TOP generation, or CPlusPlus TOP upgrade guidance.
CPlusPlus TOP can output multiple textures and can fill either CPU memory or CUDA-backed buffers depending on the plugin execute mode.
CUDA work in the plugin should run on the main thread inside the documented begin/end CUDA operation window.
The CudaTOP sample is an example project for the CPlusPlus TOP workflow; do not treat this article as recommending the legacy CUDA TOP operator.
Header files and installed samples carry important API details, so plans should avoid inventing C++ method contracts beyond this article's scope.
Plugins compiled against headers from older TouchDesigner builds may need the 2022.20000+ upgrade path before they are safe to load.
